# Crates

Generated by `codespec-docs` from `cargo metadata --no-deps`: every Rust package of the workspace, with the `description` its `Cargo.toml` gives. There are 16 packages. None is on a registry; depend on them by Git or by path. The Go adapters (`codespec-read-go`, `codespec-write-go`) are Go programs in [`adapters/go`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/adapters/go) and are not listed here.

## Components

The model, the passes, the harness, the `codespec` command and the Rust writer adapter.

| Package | Version | Directory | In Rust | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `b10x-codespec-check` | 0.6.1 | [`crates/check`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/crates/check) | `use codespec_check` | Built-in defect checks over a set of cir/1 documents: growth, randomness, integer ranges, case folding, clones, writers, dropped results, error equality, locks, timers, leaked connections, blocking accepts, waits in loops, frames, quadratic inserts, unreached functions |
| `b10x-codespec-cli` | 0.6.1 | [`crates/cli`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/crates/cli) | `use codespec_cli`, binary `codespec` | The codespec command: validate cir/1, print its schema, apply the passes, run reader and writer adapters and the comparison harness |
| `b10x-codespec-conformance` | 0.6.1 | [`crates/conformance`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/crates/conformance) | `use codespec_conformance`, binary `codespec-conformance` | The conformance kit: per-feature Go reference cases with their cir/1 modules, calls and expected outputs, the generated kit.json, and the runner that checks them |
| `b10x-codespec-effects` | 0.6.1 | [`crates/effects`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/crates/effects) | `use codespec_effects` | Effect summaries of functions outside a cir/1 module, and the effects report over a module |
| `b10x-codespec-eval` | 0.6.1 | [`crates/eval`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/crates/eval) | `use codespec_eval` | The cir/1 evaluator: a tree-walking interpreter that runs a module's functions on a calls file and prints what the native runners print, stopping with a reason at a foreign statement or an extern without a handler |
| `b10x-codespec-harness` | 0.6.1 | [`crates/harness`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/crates/harness) | `use codespec_harness` | Runs every implementation of an example on seeded traces and requires byte-equal output |
| `b10x-codespec-model` | 0.6.1 | [`crates/model`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/crates/model) | `use codespec_model` | The cir/1 code intermediate representation: Rust types, strict reading, canonical JSON and its JSON Schema |
| `b10x-codespec-passes` | 0.6.1 | [`crates/passes`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/crates/passes) | `use codespec_passes` | Passes over cir/1: lookup-guard and the whole-module facts writers read |
| `b10x-codespec-query` | 0.6.1 | [`crates/query`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/crates/query) | `use codespec_query` | cq, a typed Datalog over a fact base derived from cir/1 documents: the fact base, its cache and the interpreter codespec query runs |
| `codespec-read-c` | 0.6.1 | [`adapters/c-read`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/adapters/c-read) | `use codespec_read_c`, binary `codespec-read-c` | Reads the C11 sources of a directory into one cir/1 module from the typed AST clang prints as JSON, every expression typed from clang's own types |
| `codespec-read-rust` | 0.6.1 | [`adapters/rust-read`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/adapters/rust-read) | `use codespec_read_rust`, binary `codespec-read-rust` | Reads a Rust crate's src/lib.rs into one cir/1 module with syn and its own name and type resolution for the cir/1 subset |
| `codespec-run-c` | 0.6.1 | [`adapters/c-run`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/adapters/c-run) | `use codespec_run_c`, binary `codespec-run-c` | Compiles C written by codespec-write-c, or by hand as a C reader reads it, with cc and a generated driver that makes a conformance case's calls, printing each result in the harness encoding |
| `codespec-run-rust` | 0.6.1 | [`adapters/rust-run`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/adapters/rust-run) | `use codespec_run_rust`, binary `codespec-run-rust` | Builds a written Rust crate with cargo and makes a conformance case's calls against it, printing each result in the harness encoding |
| `codespec-write-c` | 0.6.1 | [`adapters/c`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/adapters/c) | binary `codespec-write-c` | Writes a cir/1 module as C11 with a header-only runtime for strings, slices, maps and errors, linking libc only |
| `codespec-write-rust` | 0.6.1 | [`adapters/rust`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/adapters/rust) | binary `codespec-write-rust` | Writes a cir/1 module and its facts as a Rust crate, built as syn trees and printed with prettyplease |

## Repository tooling

Generators and checks the repository's own gate runs. Nothing outside the repository depends on them.

| Package | Version | Directory | In Rust | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `codespec-docs` | 0.6.1 | [`crates/docs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/crates/docs) | binary `codespec-docs` | Generates the derived pages of the codespec documentation site (CLI, crates, cir/1, status) and checks them for drift |
